changelog: YouTube playlist entries now carry a stable source identity for source-aware scheduling, and the content-page preview expands playlists with the same source and order semantics as the server. Expired proof-of-origin tokens are now reported as expired instead of none held, while invalid resolution qualities remain unknown rather than being shown as a sentinel pixel value.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
